description: G6 knowledge-capture gate fires in skills/ivy/SKILL.md Phase 1.5 cold-start-eligible turns when an unpaired session_end exists with at least one fresh candidate. Per-session gate.

should_trigger.prompt: Resume after a refine session that fixed a deser_err pattern
Open a new session after the previous one wrote progress{kind=fix_attempt} events
First turn after a session_end with at least one decision event
Resume into idle with a recent unsound gate_verdict in the prior session

should_not_trigger.prompt: Resume into a fresh pending_dispatch (warm-resume wins)
Resume into a non-idle PROJECT.md (PROJECT.md warm-resume wins)
First turn after a session with NO Ivy activity (is_session_active was False; no session_end)
First turn with IVY_DISPATCH_G6=0 in env
First turn after G6 already ran for the most recent session_end (cycle closed)
